dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark base coat (exterior) to a high-intensity light grey perimeter (interior). The geometry of these perimeters is irregular and slightly serrated, particularly visible in the central-lateral clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters observed primarily along the dorsal ridge and interspersed between the macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the mid-section form an obtuse triangle, while a fourth, more posterior structure forms a trapezoidal relationship with the central pair.
